sisi.depan: The front of the house presents an open pendopo veranda with four polished teak pillars, carved with geometric patterns and trimmed with gold, supporting a tiered joglo roof, while a wide doorway with a softly glowing threshold leads into the main building.
sisi.kanan: On the right side of the garden, a cluster of tall, pulsating bioluminescent plants casts a warm light on a smooth stone pathway that curves around a low, sculpted hedge.
sisi.kiri: To the left, a multi-layered stone fountain etched with subtle wave motifs gently streams water over smooth river stones, set beside a single, gnarled frangipani tree and patches of manicured moss.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, the distant futuristic city skyline is visible over a high garden wall, featuring glowing, pagoda-inspired towers and faint streams of aerial traffic.
sisi.tengah: In the center of the garden lawn, a low, circular table made of dark, polished wood faces the veranda, accompanied by two large, woven floor cushions with embedded light strips along their base.
sisi.atas: The deep indigo evening sky is clear, showing a few bright stars and the faint, swirling projection of a holographic atmospheric regulator.
